why: Docs and one backlog row. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no .github/workflows/, no tests, no order path — Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list. THE CORRECTION: § 12's headline said the venue 'TRUTHFULLY reports ETHUSDT FLAT'. That word asserts the venue told us the whole truth, which an empty read cannot establish — and the reading came from an instrument that sent the same two queries the production readers send, so it was blind to any book those filters never ask about. The operator was looking at the position on the Bybit platform at that moment. An empty read is evidence about the READ. Corrected in place rather than silently edited, with § 14 stating explicitly WHAT SURVIVES (§ 9's structural two-list claim and § 13's rows[0] measurement — both rest on code read this session, not on the ETH instance; the three filters and the missing nextPageCursor are code facts) and WHAT DOES NOT (any reading of § 12 as 'there is no ETH position'), because a finding that quietly keeps a falsified exhibit is worse than no finding. Also records that hypothesis 4 is refuted only as WRONG ACCOUNT — our key returns the operator's exact XRP brackets — and NOT as wrong-or-partial KEY SCOPE, which stays open with is_sub_account still reading None ('we did not look'). THE BACKLOG ROW is a SAFETY finding observed in the act on PR #11555 this session: claude-pr-automerge ENABLED auto-merge from an arming file that rode in the same push, then pr-landing R5 refused self-landing on a Tier-2 path; removing the arming file made the guard grade 'OK — state=declared_needs_approval' WHILE AUTO-MERGE WAS STILL ARMED, confirmed by disable_pr_auto_merge returning 'Auto-merge disabled' (it does not report success on a PR that never had it). A Tier-2 change to a live real-money order-path module would have merged with no human read while every repo surface said it was correctly held. I disabled it by hand — that fixes one PR, not the class — and the row's resolution_criteria demands a POSITIVE CONTROL, because the defect is precisely a check that passes on a state it cannot see. No order was placed, modified or cancelled on any account; every venue read this session was a GET. DOCUMENT-INDEX.md untouched (no new file), so document_index.py --write was not run and remains prohibited.
